# AWS SBG JRU Centralized Member Validation API — LLM & AI Agent Integration Guide

> Machine-readable integration specification for AI coding agents (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot).

## Overview
- **Base URL (Production)**: `https://awssbgjru.me`
- **Base URL (Same-EC2 Internal Docker Network)**: `http://awssbgjru-backend:8001`
- **Scoped OpenAPI 3.1 Spec**: `GET https://awssbgjru.me/api/v1/external/openapi.json`
- **Health Check**: `GET https://awssbgjru.me/api/v1/external/health`
- **Validation Endpoint**: `POST https://awssbgjru.me/api/v1/external/validate`

## Mandatory Security Invariants for AI Agents
1. **Server-Side Only**: Always call `/api/v1/external/validate` from a backend route / server action. NEVER bundle `AWSSBG_API_KEY` into client-side browser code.
2. **Environment Variables**: Read `AWSSBG_API_URL` (default `https://awssbgjru.me`) and `AWSSBG_API_KEY` (`sbg_live_...`) from environment variables.
3. **Zero Password Logging**: Never log `password` in server logs or error trackers. Never pass credentials in URL query parameters.

## Plug-and-Play Single-File SDK Downloads (Zero Dependencies)

### JavaScript / TypeScript (Node 18+, Next.js, Express, Bun)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://awssbgjru.me/sdk/js/awssbg-auth-sdk.js -o awssbg-auth-sdk.js
curl -fsSL https://awssbgjru.me/sdk/js/awssbg-auth-sdk.d.ts -o awssbg-auth-sdk.d.ts
```

### Python 3.9+ (FastAPI, Flask, Django)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://awssbgjru.me/sdk/python/awssbg_auth_sdk.py -o awssbg_auth_sdk.py
```

## HTTP Contract: `POST /api/v1/external/validate`

### Request Headers
```http
Content-Type: application/json
X-API-Key: sbg_live_<your_secret_key>
```

### Request Body
```json
{
  "org_id": "AWSSBG-1120-001",
  "username": "j.delacruz482",
  "password": "member-password"
}
```

### Response (`200 OK` — Valid Member)
```json
{
  "valid": true,
  "reason": null,
  "member": {
    "org_id": "AWSSBG-1120-001",
    "username": "j.delacruz482",
    "first_name": "Juan",
    "last_name": "Dela Cruz",
    "full_name": "Juan Dela Cruz",
    "email": "juan.delacruz@my.jru.edu",
    "student_id": "24-123456",
    "year": "Third Year",
    "program": "BS Information Technology",
    "division_type": "skillbuilder",
    "division_name": "Cloud Computing",
    "status": "active",
    "must_change_password": true
  }
}
```

### Response (`200 OK` — Invalid Credentials or Suspended Member)
```json
{
  "valid": false,
  "reason": "invalid_credentials",
  "member": null
}
```
*(Note: `reason` is `"invalid_credentials"` for any ID/username/password mismatch, or `"inactive_member"` if the member is suspended/revoked.)*

### Error Status Codes
- `401 Unauthorized`: Missing, invalid, or revoked `X-API-Key`.
- `422 Unprocessable Entity`: Missing `org_id`, `username`, or `password` in JSON body.
- `429 Too Many Requests`: Per-key rate limit exceeded.
